name: Orchestrion Xylophone
summary: Arduino Leonardo mechanical xylophone controller with solenoid percussion, PWM velocity and configurable note range.
description: An earlier percussion controller for xylophone-style instruments. The repository states that the code works but still needs refactoring to reach the larger six-octave target.

notes: The repository documents SysEx identification, but not the modern GMB capability protocol.

mechanics.summary: One solenoid or solenoid-driven mallet strikes each xylophone bar. A switch can shift the playable octave mapping.

actuators.notes: README describes 25 notes by default and code adaptable roughly from 17 to 32 notes.

supplies.label: Solenoid supply
supplies.notes: README minimum; fuse recommendation is 2–3 A depending on build.

warnings: Legacy code path; repository says code is functional but still requires work for the larger 72-note target.
